summary: Nora can hand a long, multi-step job to a background worker and tell the room when it is done (off by default).
details: Four tools on a tag turn, only when [subagent] enabled is set: subagent_create starts the job and returns at once, subagent_list and subagent_read show this room's jobs and how far a running one is, subagent_cancel stops one.
A job is room-scoped: a job id from another room is treated as unknown.
The result arrives later as one message with the documents' links.
limitations: Shipped off: nothing changes until [subagent] enabled = true, which also needs [dreamer], [compute], [computer] and [documents].
The routing of subagent_create against a plain reply is unmeasured on the live model.
